navigationModel.admin: persistent event-scoped rail with route destinations
navigationModel.evaluator: focused queue shell with no admin module rail
navigationModel.speaker: mobile-first home with Tasks, Profile, and My sessions subviews
navigationModel.public: event header with Sessions, Speakers, Agenda, and Itinerary

labelDecisions.reason: names the user outcome and removes slash-language
labelDecisions.governance: requires a label-only amendment to the ratified Lumen IA before implementation

labelDecisions.reason: clearer for new operators and more consistent with the route purpose
labelDecisions.governance: requires a label-only amendment to the ratified Lumen IA before implementation

labelDecisions.reason: describes the admin task while retaining Lumen as an internal system name

pages.purpose: Answer whether the active program is on track and what needs action now.
pages.defaultView: readiness dashboard with four outcome metrics and a ranked attention queue
pages.detailBehavior: attention items deep-link to the owning route
pages.mobile: single-column attention-first summary

pages.purpose: Build, preview, publish, and share the event proposal form.
pages.defaultView: outline + direct-manipulation form canvas + contextual inspector
pages.detailBehavior: select a field to edit it in the inspector; preview uses the real public renderer
pages.mobile: canvas with outline and inspector as full-height sheets

pages.purpose: Find, compare, assign, and decide proposal records.
pages.defaultView: filterable table with master-detail pane
pages.detailBehavior: desktop side pane; mobile full-screen detail preserving list state
pages.mobile: record list with title, speaker, status, score, and filter sheet

pages.purpose: Understand evaluation coverage, bottlenecks, and assignment risk.
pages.defaultView: coverage table grouped by submission
pages.detailBehavior: side pane with assignment progress and reassignment actions
pages.mobile: summary cards followed by compact grouped list

pages.purpose: Move accepted participants from invitation to program-ready.
pages.defaultView: lifecycle table over event participations, not a portrait gallery
pages.detailBehavior: side pane with contact, sessions, tasks, files, and communication history
pages.mobile: priority list with readiness indicators and full-screen detail

pages.purpose: Place sessions, resolve constraints, and publish a valid program.
pages.defaultView: day-by-room studio with unscheduled tray
pages.detailBehavior: select a tile for timing, room, speaker, and conflict details
pages.mobile: day agenda editor with explicit Place/Move actions instead of a compressed grid

pages.purpose: Create, verify, send, and audit event communication campaigns.
pages.defaultView: campaign index grouped by Draft, Scheduled, Sending, and Sent
pages.detailBehavior: new/edit campaign uses Audience → Message → Review → Send sequence
pages.mobile: campaign list; builder steps become separate full-width screens

pages.purpose: Configure the active event and controlled workspace capabilities.
pages.defaultView: two-pane settings shell with Event selected
pages.detailBehavior: one save region per settings page with dirty-state protection
pages.mobile: settings index followed by a dedicated detail route

pages.purpose: Safely prepare and publish the public event identity.
pages.defaultView: token controls beside a scoped live public preview
pages.detailBehavior: publish is blocked on contrast or unsafe asset failure
pages.mobile: controls first, preview second, sticky draft/publish status

pages.purpose: Define the criteria evaluators use consistently.
pages.defaultView: ordered criteria editor with live evaluator preview
pages.detailBehavior: inline criterion editing with keyboard reorder
pages.mobile: one criterion card at a time with move controls

pages.purpose: Define repeatable speaker-readiness tasks.
pages.defaultView: ordered template list with detail editor
pages.detailBehavior: select template for due rule, required state, and instructions
pages.mobile: template list then full-screen editor

pages.purpose: Create, inspect, and revoke scoped machine credentials.
pages.defaultView: active-key table with Create key action
pages.detailBehavior: secret shown once; high-risk scopes separated and default-denied
pages.mobile: stacked key records with scope summary and explicit revoke flow

pages.purpose: Understand one-way projection health and recover failures.
pages.defaultView: health summary followed by failed/stale projection records
pages.detailBehavior: failure detail explains impact, last attempt, and safe retry
pages.mobile: status summary and actionable failure list

pages.purpose: Complete assigned evaluations with minimal context switching.
pages.defaultView: assignment queue plus focused proposal/rubric workspace
pages.detailBehavior: desktop split view; autosaved rubric and private notes
pages.mobile: queue list opens a full-screen review with Back to queue

pages.purpose: Show participation state and the single most important next action.
pages.defaultView: next-action dashboard with profile progress and session record
pages.detailBehavior: subviews use the same existing portal data and commands
pages.mobile: bottom navigation; desktop uses a compact top/sub navigation

pages.purpose: Help a prospective speaker understand the opportunity and submit a strong proposal.
pages.defaultView: event introduction followed by a four-step guided form
pages.detailBehavior: save and return later; completion explains next steps
pages.mobile: single-column form with progress and reachable save/continue actions

pages.purpose: Browse the published program by topic and track.
pages.defaultView: searchable vertical session-card list sorted by day and time
pages.detailBehavior: expand or link speaker names; do not expose internal submission data
pages.mobile: full-width compact cards with sticky day/track filters

pages.purpose: Discover the people appearing in the public program.
pages.defaultView: searchable responsive portrait directory with text-first fallback
pages.detailBehavior: dedicated /speakers/:speakerId detail with bio and public sessions
pages.mobile: two-column compact directory or one-column when names/bios are long

pages.purpose: Compare concurrent sessions across rooms for a selected day.
pages.defaultView: day tabs with room columns and time-aligned sessions
pages.detailBehavior: session cards expose time, track, speakers, and room
pages.mobile: day tabs plus room filter; chronological list for the selected room

pages.purpose: Follow the complete event in one chronological stream; this is not a personal agenda.
pages.defaultView: day-grouped ordered timeline across all rooms
pages.detailBehavior: clear room changes and simultaneous-session grouping
pages.mobile: single vertical timeline optimized for what happens next

pages.purpose: Request or exchange a secure sign-in link without product distraction.
pages.defaultView: single centered authentication card
pages.detailBehavior: confirmation replaces the form and states delivery/retry behavior
pages.mobile: full-width card with no admin navigation
